title: Lessee Fee Reduction on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Extension
content:
**Relationship desk card — customers who also hold a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease.** On an extension of a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract, the customer's lease record can reduce the extension fee.

**Rule.** When the customer holds an active Kestrel lease (a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease in active status) and the customer's Kestrel lease ledger shows at least 12 lease payments and no lease late charge in the last 12 calendar months, 5.00 dollars are taken off the extension fee; when the customer holds an active Kestrel lease and the lease ledger shows no more than one lease late charge in the last 12 calendar months, where the first condition is not met, 2.50 dollars are taken off; in every other case nothing is taken off.

The dollars come off the extension fee as figured for the contract from the tier's extension fee, and the fee is never below zero.

| Active lease | Lease payments, last 12 calendar months | Lease late charges, last 12 calendar months | Taken off |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or more | none | 5.00 dollars |
| yes | 12 or more | one | 2.50 dollars |
| yes | fewer than 12 | none or one | 2.50 dollars |
| yes | any | two or more | nothing |
| no | any | any | nothing |

**Counting.** Lease payments and lease late charges are the entries on the customer's Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease ledger, by their dates. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.
